evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
Reef-monitoring satellites could also be used to report sea surface temperatures, thermal stress on coral, and bathymetry

criteria.reasoning: Clear mission purpose (GBR bleaching monitoring), identified users (marine/conservation scientists), strong need justification with statistics and four cited sources. However, no explicit mission objectives/requirements list (orbit, resolution, coverage targets), keeping it at the lower end of Accomplished.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.
I will need to choose an optimal orbit path and altitude, and also calculate COEs & AOEs.

criteria.reasoning: Week-by-week Gantt chart with colour-coded completion status, deadlines, and detailed task narratives tied to the mission (launch, orbit, ground control, comms, end of life). Information sources listed. Lacks explicit contingency/variation provisions, so lower end of Accomplished.

evidence.quote: I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii, researched into how coral bleaching occurs and its severity, and also completed STK tutorials 1, 2, 3 & 4.

criteria.reasoning: Evidence of work: literature reading, completed mission concept, and four STK tutorials. However, no preliminary technical results (no orbit calculations, payload sizing, or simulation outputs) are presented or interpreted, so progress is real but modest.

technical_issues.issue: No quantitative mission requirements (orbit altitude, revisit time, spatial/spectral resolution, payload definition) despite proposing imaging for bleaching detection.
No preliminary technical results shown; STK tutorial completion is asserted but not evidenced with outputs or interpretation.
References are raw URLs with footnote superscripts rather than a properly formatted, cited reference list.
Gantt chart lacks a figure number/caption.

overall: A well-written, clearly structured preliminary report with a compelling GBR monitoring mission concept, a detailed Gantt-chart plan, and listed sources. Main gaps: no explicit mission requirements, no preliminary technical results beyond tutorials, and informal referencing.
